Use body 20px, heading 36px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 16px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Set headings in Junicode and reading text in Aileron; humanist reading serif with economical sans text. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
